description: One page of the weekly x402 demand insights report for $0.05, where the whole report is $0.25: repeat demand by category, demand gaps, movers, the price index with the listings that changed price, strong listings with weak descriptions, or GET against POST. Every metric of that page as JSON with Markdown, and its cited sources, for the latest or any archived week. The contents are free at /contents. Price: $0.05 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $0.05 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.

page.description: Which page. category_demand: Where repeat demand is: each category's repeat calls, share, busiest listing and leaders. demand_gaps: Demand gaps: categories with real repeat demand and few strong sellers. movers: Movers: listings that gained payers, new listings with traction, and drop-outs. price_index: Price index: points by category, and the listings that cut or raised their price. thin_leaders: Strong listings with weak descriptions. method_traction: GET versus POST: how often each reaches 3+ payers.
